prompts: Edit target: supplied crop from the user's anime river keyframe. Produce a precision 2 by 2 animation cel sheet, four panels, no borders/gutters/text, total 2048x1996 if possible. Each panel exactly repeats the supplied crop's camera, subject scale, head size, seated pelvis position, canoe outline and fixed background. Read panels left to right, top to bottom as four successive poses of ONE restrained canoe paddle stroke. TOP LEFT: blade entering water ahead, upper hand 12 pixels forward relative to reference crop; TOP RIGHT: pull through water, torso inclines just slightly forward; BOTTOM LEFT: end of pull with hands nearer torso, blade behind starting location; BOTTOM RIGHT: recover paddle above water and reach forward. Draw visibly distinct anatomically coherent arms, elbow bends, grip and paddle angle in each panel. Keep head approximately same fixed coordinates; chest/arm lengths identical. Exact same adult Dairon, clothes, ink lines, textured anime paint, colors and moonlight. Preserve the woman's tiny partial silhouette on left and the entire wood canoe shape precisely in every panel. Changes constrained inside central region; all edges should match reference. Do not shift or scale the camera, do not enlarge his head/body, no new characters, no added splashes above the hull, no captions. This is a registered animation component, not a storyboard.

Using this 2x2 four-key-pose paddle animation sheet as strict identity, proportions, size and camera reference, produce a 4-column by 2-row sheet of EIGHT IN-BETWEEN DRAWINGS, NO borders, gutters, captions. Every tile is square-ish same 400:390 aspect ratio as reference panels. Tile1: one-third between reference top-left and top-right; tile2: two-thirds between top-left/top-right. Tile3: one-third between top-right and bottom-left; tile4: two-thirds between top-right/bottom-left. Tile5: one-third between bottom-left and bottom-right; tile6: two-thirds between bottom-left/bottom-right. Tile7: one-third between bottom-right and top-left; tile8: two-thirds between bottom-right/top-left. Preserve exactly seated Dairon's head/hips coordinates, head size, cloth, anatomy, hair, canoe rim, night river and tiny woman's fragment on far left from the reference in EVERY cell. Animate just anatomically correct arm and paddle stroke motion between those key poses. Same textured ink painted anime style. NO camera move, NO resizing character or hull. Each cell complete crop with identical fixed background placement. Keep layout 4 columns and 2 rows strictly.

Edit target: the supplied Amaia face crop. Create a perfectly registered 2x2 animation cel sheet, no lines gutters numbers or captions. Each panel uses exactly the original crop framing, scale, face proportions, colors, stroke detail, curly hair silhouette, neck and shoulder locations. Four drawings of a quiet blink: top left her eyes slightly softened, half lowered lids still looking left; top right both eyes fully closed; bottom left eyes halfway reopening; bottom right eyes open, gaze now slightly lower to her sleeping child. Change ONLY her eyelids and pupils; keep EVERY other contour and feature and hair and background registered identically to the reference. Mouth stays closed in the original resting expression. No head turn, no change to pose or head size, no new lines or added accessories. Preserve adult woman likeness, brown skin, white ponytail tie, graphite textured anime paint. Whole sheet 2000x1440 if possible. This is a technical cel sheet to crop and composite ONLY eye regions, not a storyboard.
